children: PEB Holding AS, a company controlled by Pål E. Bratlie, CEO in Wavetrain Systems AS which is a subsidiary of Nordic Technology Group AS (“NTG”) has acquired 50,000 shares at an average price of NOK 1.21 per share. After the acquisition, PEB Holding AS owns 50,000 shares in Nordic Technology Group AS.

This information is considered to be inside information pursuant to the EU Market Abuse Regulation and is subject to the disclosure requirements pursuant to section 5-12 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.

Nordic Technology Group AS (NTG) is the majority owner of two sensor technology companies, Hammertech AS and Wavetrain Systems AS, both offering highly competitive solutions in large global markets. Listed on Euronext Growth Oslo, NTG focuses on building long-term shareholder value through active ownership of innovative technology companies with strong growth potential. NTG targets industries where technological differentiation, scalability and sustainability are key drivers of competitive advantage.

This information is information that Nordic Technology Group is obliged to make public pursuant to the EU Market Abuse Regulation. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-09-11 14:28 CEST.
